edits.proposed: Casilla 4 '4. edits.field_name: Place where the withholding was made
edits.current: City or municipality where the withholding was practised - not necessarily the employer's registered domicile, and not necessarily the employee's place of work.
edits.proposed: City or municipality where the withholding was practised - not necessarily the employer's registered domicile, and not necessarily the employee's place of work. It is a withholding-agent parameter (an employer setting), not an employee attribute: the client prints one fixed value, 'MEDELLIN' (upper case, no accents), on every row of its tax-year-2025 Form 220 working table, which pairs it with the DIVIPOLA code 05001 in the casilla-34 and casilla-35 columns. Output the municipality NAME that corresponds to the DANE code of casillas 34 and 35, so that the three casillas always describe the same place.
edits.reason: Round 1 had no evidence; the client file shows one fixed agent-level place (MEDELLIN) paired with 05001; evidence phrase aligned with the casilla-34/35 correction.
